contract: When --telemetry is explicitly supplied without --stub, use that file or return exit 1 with targeted stderr and no JSON stdout; do not silently scan --runs-dir. Preserve stub precedence, implicit discovery, successful selected-file result bytes, parsing and calibration math.
independent_cases: Missing explicit file alongside three distinct passing fallback logs must exit 1 without JSON, identify selected telemetry and path, no traceback.
Missing explicit file without a fallback directory must yield the same targeted selected-file error.
Dangling symlink selected file must not switch to valid fallback logs.
Existing directory selected as telemetry must exit 1 with targeted stderr and no JSON or traceback.
Invalid UTF-8 selected file must exit 1 with targeted stderr and no JSON or traceback.
Controlled read PermissionError must exit 1 with targeted stderr and no JSON or traceback; distinguish this injected error seam from native filesystem evidence.

Explicit valid selected telemetry gains 7,13,20,10 at level1 NORMAL with no supports has count4, median_error3, pct_within_2=0.25, pass=false and exit2, even with passing fallback logs; stdout byte-identical to original.
Changed valid selected telemetry gains 10,12 at level1 NORMAL has count2, median_error1, pct_within_2=1, pass=true and exit0; stdout byte-identical to original.
Mixed level3 GOOD, two supports, 20% growth has literal prediction28.4592; gain28 expected error0.4592; original and candidate results remain identical within float tolerance.

Implicit --runs-dir scans nested telemetry, sim-telemetry and flat JSONL fixtures, returns count3, median_error1, pct_within_2=1, pass=true, files_scanned3 and exit0; stdout byte-identical to original.
--stub with missing or invalid selected file preserves precedence and original bytes, returns five synthetic records and exit0; no real-workload claim.
Valid empty selected file preserves original count0 JSON, warning and exit0 instead of switching to fallback.
Valid JSONL parse policy with blank and malformed lines remains unchanged.
Original source/table/input bytes and unrelated sentinel files unchanged by all controls.
limits: No Rust or native simulator execution; pure Python calibration selection boundary.
Synthetic JSONL demonstrates selection and unchanged arithmetic, not model calibration validity or measured accuracy.
Calibration JSON is stdout; the CLI has no output-file option, so no invented output-file transaction claim.
